title: Agent architectural review and ground-up rebuild

completion_criteria.text: Current-state audit complete: every gap in the roster, the agent definitions and the observation machinery identified with measured evidence from the ledger and the definition files.
Audit delivered in a form the user can read and navigate - a self-contained HTML explainer with diagrams, written for a reader with no prior domain knowledge.
Target architecture designed and approved by the user: roster shape, tool grants, who may delegate, and how the configuration observes itself.
Instruction-layer correctness fixes shipped ahead of the rebuild: two dead agent references repointed, StructuredOutput granted to all 15 agents, and the unenforceable confirmation claim deleted.
Verification machinery the observer work rests on repaired and re-runnable: archive verifier, one routing-table contract, three repo checks in CI, duckdb in the receipts workflow.
Agent and observer teardown and rebuild executed without breaking the live coupling surface: rules and skills naming agents by string, 18 worktrees carrying roster copies, derived residuals.
Verified in real use, in a window opening only after U7.1 ships: the observer attributes every run and records an outcome, and the Lead share of dispatches is measured against a pre-pinned threshold.

spine.active_goal: Execute waves 6 and 7: repoint every reference to a retiring agent, delete the nine, then measure the new configuration in real use.
spine.next_step: START HERE, FRESH SESSION. Waves 4 and 5 are LIVE on main at c8c4cad0 and verified. Dispatch wave 6 then wave 7, in order, per user instruction. U6.1: repoint DECOMPOSER_AGENT at decompose-emit.mjs:16 to investigator, update agent-schema-lint.test.mjs's derived set. U6.2 (after U6.1): repoint the 17 sites, wire retirement-census into the CI matrix, flip four assertions in retirement-census.test.mjs. U7.1 (after U6.2): delete the nine. Only then c5.
spine.last_session: Waves 4 and 5 landed and were verified live on main. The stacked-merge trap fired and was recovered as PR 210. c5 was rewritten to make its routing clause measurable rather than extended with new scope.

open_risks.text: Run the retirement census from the PRIMARY checkout, never a worktree — it resolves through git commondir and censuses the primary checkout while appearing to measure your branch
Wave 6 must flip FOUR assertions in retirement-census.test.mjs, not the one the earlier risk named — :245 dereferences result.sites[0].path and THROWS once U6.2 empties the site list

Decide the .claude/skills/report/ directory before counting U6.2 done — four of its seventeen sites sit there and decision 0481 withdrew the skill, so deleting discharges all four while retaining obliges repointing them

Do not read a dispatchable-agent-schema-capable pass as roster-wide coverage — it inspects only 5 of 22 agents, seeing solely names that appear as engine string literals, and passed U4.1's four by never looking
Expect 19 name+line pairs across 18 distinct sites as the pre-wave-6 baseline — tool-routing.md:30 names two retiring agents on one line, so the two counts legitimately differ and neither is wrong

Pin the Lead-share threshold before the measurement window opens and open it only after U7.1 ships — a log gathered while both rosters are live cannot tell a Lead not chosen from a retired agent still available
Give the nine runnerless shell tests a runner before source changes alongside them — the enforcer selects them and dies, taking the gate with it
Give every concurrently dispatched agent its own mktemp -d scratch namespace — four agents collided in the shared scratchpad, and one can report a sibling's exit code as its own
Grade a Node suite on its fail counter, never by grepping for "not ok" — the runner uses the spec reporter rather than TAP, so that grep returns zero for a suite in any state

key_decisions.title: The audit pass characterises the current state and recommends nothing
Replace all 56 agents with 13 in four bands, with the dispatch tool held only by the Opus leads
Terminate review loops by closing the reviewer's question, not by capping rounds or turns
Rebuild the observer to append one line per run and do everything else at audit time
Put load-bearing rules in agent bodies, generated from shared fragments with a drift check
User rulings on the six open rebuild questions, and the addition of the observer to this thread
Always reproduce a bug before diagnosing it, and test the fix for cause rather than effect
Skills reach agents only by preload, and the dispatch tool goes to Leads only
Withdraw the report skill and put the answer-format standard in every agent body
Keep the code-reviewer agent, adopt receiving-code-review, drop requesting-code-review
security-reviewer uses neither /security-review nor claude-security
Keep release-engineer broad; the real problem is per-duty procedure loading
The zero-compliance measurement was an instrumentation artifact; re-ground the channel thesis on documentation
The report artifact is outside repo scope, so its codename and CDN findings are ratified, not defects
Read the capability marker from the subagent's own output; scanning the parent transcript over-counts 52x
Delete the destructive-operation confirmation rule; the deny list is the whole control
Drop model and effort from the observer record; the payload never carries them
Re-ground the decision set: preload confirmed, three citations stale, two records narrate unexecuted state
The approved target architecture: 13 agents in four bands, with dispatch and skill invocation held by the Leads
Preload only skills at or under 4KB; larger procedures become body-carried pointers resolved at generation time
Claude in Chrome reproduces; the re-runnable artifact is the investigator's obligation, not the tool's
Update plugins first then clean; reclaim 110 MB and accept 27 MB pinned by a dead worktree
Execute waves 0 through 3 next session; hold waves 4 through 7 until the mitosis engine lands
Strike the unidentifiable backup profiles from c4, and correct the stale worktree count in the same clause
Execute waves 0 to 3 by direct per-unit dispatch, not through the mitosis skill
Cost and permission_denials are unreachable from hooks, so the prose is wrong and they are not fields
Resolve the canonical roster by requiring two independent derivations to agree, and halt when they do not
Parameterise the canonical resolver by subpath, and never canonicalise one side of a comparison
Repoint the continuity ledger rule fully rather than only fixing the two names that dangle
Stack pull requests for blocked MSP chains, with mandatory parent-branch deletion before each child merge
The observer record is ten fields, with parent, depth and agent type read from the platform sidecar
Standing order: a bare Approved or Go in a fresh session executes wave 3 by fan-out dispatch, no further confirmation
Unit leads are general-purpose agents, because no roster specialist holds the Agent tool needed to fan out
Wave 3 executes as a four-link linear stack, with capability_blocked inserted as U3.3b before the cutover
The engine gate on waves 4 to 7 is satisfied and lifted; the SPEC section 6 table wins over section 5a
Waves 0 to 2 audit: three gaps become one flat remediation MSP, the census grammar gap is filed against U6.2
capability_blocked ships as a thirteen-field derived row with a bounded tail fallback, and moves ahead of U3.3
U3.4 must register the new observer in the global settings, not merely delete the old analyzer from it
U3.3 answers four standing questions, refuses two loudly, and reports coverage rather than claiming disuse
Artifact-less internal subagents are most of the log, so every audit rate must separate them from real dispatches
Wave 3 closes; its three ladder downgrades share one shape and name a real capability gap
Nine shell tests have no runner at all, and the enforcer will select and die on them the moment source changes alongside
U6.2 gets a grammar-free retirement census; U6.1 and U7.1 are repaired with it
Waves 4 and 5 are blocked on a missing generator substrate, shipped as its own unit first
The main thread dispatches one researcher; the researcher owns the fan-out inside its question
Waves 4 and 5 found four substrate gaps; three are fixed, the effort dial is a SPEC defect
The spec store's dynamic import halts the determinism census; register a declared exception
Agent specs become JSON data rather than weakening the determinism census
The four wave PRs are file-disjoint siblings on the substrate, landed after one parent-branch deletion
The shipped-store test becomes filesystem-derived and byte-identical across all five branches
Pointer resolution partitions specs per host rather than scoping the whole check away
Waves 4 and 5 recovered as one integration pull request after four merged into a live base
c5's routing clause becomes a measured Lead share, sequenced strictly after wave 7 ships
Delete the report skill directory in U6.2 and repoint the three references the census cannot see
Wave 6 lands as one pull request carrying U6.1 and U6.2 as atomic commits, wave 7 as its own
Ground every claim about an agent capability in the agent file on disk, never in decision 0481

out_of_scope: Cutting the standing instruction load for volume alone - the question is re-scoping with path globs, and the binary trace confirmed rules are the eager per-dispatch cost while skills are lazy.
Migrating the retired project-local agents' domain knowledge into skills and rules - the report places this as a SEPARATE task after the agent and observer rework, not inside it.
